newsitem.title: USA: Connie Lee has capacity for N.Y. State Dorm bonds.
newsitem.headline: Connie Lee has capacity for N.Y. State Dorm bonds.

text.p: Connie Lee Insurance Co said Tuesday it has limited secondary market insurance capacity for the following issues:
--New York State Med Care/Dormitory Authority mental health facilities bonds, with 20-year maximum maturities.
--New York State Dormitory Authority, State University System, with 10-year maximum maturities.
Capacity is available in $1 million minimum block sizes and on a first-come, first-served basis, Connie Lee said.
For more information, call Larry Weiss at 202-728-3436 or 800-877-5333.
